components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main copper action for a page or form.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.65rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-on-accent); padding: 0.72rem 1rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.2; transition: transform 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent-strong); background: var(--color-accent-strong); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action for secondary navigation and product workflows.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.65rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-surface-strong); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 0.72rem 1rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.2; box-shadow: var(--shadow-restraint); transition: transform 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong); background: var(--color-surface-muted); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Warm dark field for search, auth, profile, and exchange forms.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; color: var(--color-ink-soft); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 750; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-input-bg); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 0.875rem 1rem; font: inherit; outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(var(--color-ink-rgb), 0.02); transition: border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-placeholder); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 70%, var(--color-surface-strong)); background: var(--color-input-focus-bg); box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }

components.css: .ds-book-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5rem 1fr; gap: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0.7rem; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 1rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-restraint); transition: transform 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-book-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--color-border-strong); background: var(--color-card-hover); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift); } .ds-book-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-book-cover { display: grid; height: 7rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--cover-paper-border); border-radius: 0.7rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cover-paper-from), var(--cover-paper-via), var(--cover-paper-to)); color: var(--cover-paper-text); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: var(--cover-shadow); } .ds-card-label { margin: 0 0 0.35rem; color: var(--color-accent); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.16em; } .ds-card-author { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: var(--color-blue); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Sticky translucent navigation shared by Landing and product surfaces.
components.css: .ds-top-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-nav); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; color: var(--color-ink); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); } .ds-brand-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-mark-book { position: relative; display: inline-grid; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0.7rem; background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-restraint); } .ds-mark-book::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0.6rem auto 0.6rem 0.75rem; width: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent); } .ds-mark-book::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 1.1rem; top: 0.75rem; width: 1.25rem; height: 1.7rem; border: 1px solid var(--brand-page-border); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--brand-page-bg); transform: rotate(-6deg); }

narrative.overview: Book Exchange already has the bones of a warm, serious library interface: dark shelves, paper surfaces, copper actions, restrained borders, serif display type, and compact product panels. The Landing page is allowed to become cinematic, story-led, and materially rich. The authenticated app remains a calm workspace.
keyCharacteristics: Dark editorial library atmosphere with warm paper and copper accents.
Book-first visual language through covers, shelves, catalog cards, and exchange states.
Serif display typography for editorial weight, system sans for task clarity.
Quiet product components with visible focus, semantic states, and reduced-motion support.
Landing ambition contained to the public brand surface, not leaked into routine workflows.

rules.name: The Copper Rarity Rule
rules.body: Copper is a signal, not a wash. If more than roughly 10 percent of a product screen is copper, the interface is shouting.

rules.name: The Paper Material Rule
rules.body: Paper tones should feel like surfaces that hold content. Do not use warm neutrals as filler decoration around unrelated UI.

rules.name: The Library Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif type is for bookish hierarchy and atmosphere; sans type is for action and comprehension.

rules.name: The Lift Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear because something is interactive, floating, selected, or urgent. Never add soft shadows just to make a section feel designed.

dos: Do treat the Landing page as the brand surface for cinematic book storytelling.
Do preserve the authenticated product interface as a calm, task-first workspace.
Do use warm paper, copper, serif display type, and physical book details when they clarify the Book Exchange identity.
Do keep reduced-motion behavior for route transitions, theme changes, and the future scroll story.
Do let the future 3D book feel materially connected to the existing BookCover language.
Do use full-bleed scenes, scroll pacing, and asymmetric editorial moments on Landing when they serve the story.
Do keep forms, tables, nav, errors, empty states, and toasts predictable and accessible.
donts: Don't make the brand playful, cartoonish, neon, fantasy, or generic SaaS.
Don't add excessive cards, nested boxes, decorative clutter, loud gradients, mascot-like illustration, or stock startup dashboard visuals.
Don't turn every Landing section into a tiny uppercase eyebrow plus headline plus identical card grid.
Don't use template metric blocks as the proof of value; show books, exchange behavior, and atmosphere instead.
Don't spread cinematic motion into /app/*, auth forms, admin tools, or routine exchange workflows.
Don't use colored side-stripes or broad ghost-card shadows as new decorative scaffolding.
Don't let the 3D or scroll-driven experience hide content, trap keyboard users, or fail when reduced motion is enabled.
